GOOD TO KNOW

Questions,
answered.

Need help with a plan or offer? Ask the team directly on WhatsApp.

What is the difference between the plans?＋

Cardio Only includes treadmill, cycling and elliptical access. Gym Only includes strength, dumbbells and machine area. Gym + Cardio includes full gym and cardio. Student Full Access includes full gym and cardio; confirm eligibility and terms with the gym.

Does Cardio Only include weights?＋

No. Gym strength-training access is excluded from Cardio Only.

Does Gym Only include cardio?＋

No. Cardio is excluded from Gym Only.

How does the student offer work?＋

Student Full Access is PKR 6,000 per month, with an advertised saving of PKR 2,000 compared with regular full access. Confirm eligibility and terms with the gym.

Is the admission promotion a free membership month?＋

No. The PKR 10,000 admission fee is advertised as waived for the first month. Monthly membership charges still apply.

What are the training hours?＋

Morning Prime: 6:00 AM–11:00 AM. Female-Only Privacy Slot: 11:00 AM–4:30 PM. Evening Co-Time: 4:30 PM–11:30 PM; operations may extend until midnight.

Where is Savyora Fitness?＋

Ground Floor, Rabbani Heights, Nasir Bagh Road, Malakandher, Peshawar, near Naseer Teaching Hospital.

How do I ask about coaching?＋

Contact the team on WhatsApp to enquire about coaching and nutrition with Aiman Hamid.
